title: CulFiT: A Fine-grained Cultural-aware LLM Training Paradigm via Multilingual Critique Data Synthesis
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures culturally-aware knowledge, which includes the sub-domain of religion. Specifically, it evaluates a model's ability to answer open-ended questions about religious and cultural norms, such as the varied enforcement and interpretation of hijab regulations across different regions.
findings: The paper's proposed training paradigm, CulFiT, enhances a model's cultural awareness, enabling it to provide more nuanced and knowledgeable responses to questions on religious-cultural topics. For example, CulFiT-trained models better capture the specific cultural nuances of religious practices (like hijab regulations) compared to baseline models, which tend to give vague or incorrect answers. The evaluation also includes performance on a broad set of 'world religions' questions via the MMMLU benchmark.
